feedback: The solution passes all acceptance tests, but it fails to meet several explicit requirements. The tagline is never rendered, muted text tokens are missing a proper value for contrast, the not‑found page may not provide a clear home link, and the mobile menu accessibility attributes are incomplete. Update the implementation to render the tagline, define a proper muted text colour that satisfies contrast, ensure the 404 page includes an accessible link back home, and add the missing ARIA attributes to the mobile navigation panel and its toggle button.
unproven: The tagline defined as TAGLINE in src/content/site.ts is not rendered on any page, violating R7 which requires the tagline "Evidence-driven AI, built for your business." to be shown on the site.

The theme tokens for text color (mutedText) in src/theme/tokens.ts are incorrectly set to the same value as text (#2B3645) instead of a distinct muted color, and the contrast test in __tests__/acceptance/theme.test.ts expects a separate muted text color that meets WCAG AA on white. This violates requirement R114 (text colours meet WCAG AA contrast) because mutedText does not provide sufficient contrast for muted text usage.

The Page not found page (src/pages/NotFoundPage.tsx) does not include a visible link back to the home page as required by R110 (the Page not found page has a link back to the home page (/)). The test for this passes only checking for an <a> with href='/', but the implementation may not have proper accessible link text or placement.

The navigation collapse menu does not add aria-controls to the mobile navigation panel correctly: the panel uses id='mobile-nav' but the button's aria-controls attribute is set to a variable panelId that matches 'mobile-nav', which is correct. However, the mobile navigation panel lacks role='navigation' or appropriate aria-label matching tests for the Menu button expanding/collapsing. This may cause failures for R15-R17.
